intro: Welcome to Workout number one. Ten ab exercises. Let's get after it.
rest: Good job. Cool down and breathe.
Great. Shake it out and recover.
complete: And that's a wrap! Workout complete. Amazing job today.
ex_basic_crunch: Basic crunch. Feet flat, hands behind your head. Lift your shoulders off the mat, then lower slowly.
ex_right_oblique: Right oblique crunch. Bring your right elbow across toward your left knee, and squeeze your side.
ex_left_oblique: Left oblique crunch. Bring your left elbow across toward your right knee, and squeeze.
ex_bicycle: Bicycle crunch. Hands behind your head. Pedal your legs, and twist elbow to opposite knee.
ex_reverse: Reverse crunch. Knees up at ninety degrees. Curl your hips off the mat, and pull your knees to your chest.
ex_long_arm: Long arm crunch. Arms straight overhead, biceps by your ears. Crunch up, and keep those arms long.
ex_crossover: Crossover crunch. Cross your right ankle over your left knee. Bring your left elbow toward your right knee.
ex_half_curl: Half curl. Reach your hands toward your knees. Curl halfway up, pause, and lower with control.
ex_vertical_leg: Vertical leg crunch. Legs straight up toward the ceiling. Crunch up, and reach your chest toward your feet.
ex_plank: Plank. Forearms down, elbows under your shoulders. Keep one straight line from head to heels, and hold.
